decision: Measure the strongest current artifact under the official 30/40/30 rubric after correcting same-judge replica exposure.
population: Six scoreable frozen artifacts; generic prompt and generic RFP-copilot classes are qualitative UNSCORABLE baselines.
assignment_constraint: Every lane contains every candidate exactly once; one judge owns one lane only.
aggregation: Per-lane anchor correction followed by candidate median under relevance 30, technical 40, completeness 30.
identity_rule: Identity mapping remains private until sealed-aggregate.json exists.
pairwise_plan: Top two receive two AB and two BA judgments; warn when left-position wins exceed 65 percent of non-ties.
promotion_rule: Highest corrected median must also pass hard gates and win the balanced pairwise final consistently.
recording_note: This index was added after execution to make the already-frozen pre-score v2 protocol explicit. It does not replace or rewrite the freeze manifest, assignments, sealed aggregate, or preserved v1 failure history.
